method: Tempo is measured in the selected note value per minute, so each tempo beat lasts 60/BPM seconds. A written bar contains meter beats x 4/meter unit quarter-note beats; phrase length converts those quarter-note beats into selected tempo beats. Voice n starts after (n-1) entry gaps and performs the phrase for the selected number of repeats. Its finish is its start plus the performed phrase duration, and the full round ends when the last voice finishes. Start and finish positions are 1-based written bars and beats; an endpoint exactly on a barline is shown as beat 1 of the following bar. Decimal gaps are supported from 0.25 to 128 tempo beats. Pickup bars, fermatas, tempo changes and performance nuances are excluded; all arithmetic runs locally without storage or network access.
